QuestInfo.name: Teo's Even Weirder Hobby
QuestInfo.0: It seems like #p102# in #m10000000# still has more weird stuff he wants to collect.
QuestInfo.1: #p102# in #m10000000# asked me for even weirder items to complete his collection. He said he absolutely NEEDS an intact #b#t4000008##k... Why is he even collecting this kind of stuff?

0.0: Look who it is! My friend who helped me out before! Seeing you still hanging around the harbor, you must be as bored as ever, haha! This is perfect timing. To tell you the truth, there is another item I want to add to my weird item collection.
0.1: If you go a bit further from the harbor, you can easily find those fierce #r#o8#s#k. I need you to hunt them down and bring back a clean #b#t4000008##k without a single scratch. Most people would want other parts from them, but... I trust you understand me, haha!

1.0: So, how did it go with the item I asked for? Let's see... Now this is a truly intact #b#t4000008##k! Haha, I knew I could count on you!
1.1: Thanks to you, my weird item collection is finally coming together. My dream is to one day build a museum like the world has never seen before. Here, take this useful potion as a reward.

yes.0: I got this from a pirate I met a while back, but I have no use for it. It might come in handy for someone like you, though. Take care of yourself and drop by every now and then!

item.0: Still no sign of the #b#t4000008##k I asked for? That's a real problem... It is an absolute must-have for my weird item collection.

mob.0: You haven't forgotten about hunting the #o8#s, have you?
